{{Quote|The one in the barn, that'll do.''"<br />"''That's ''our'' ride. It doesn't go anywhere without ''us'', and right now, we're busy.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Sugi (bounty hunter)/Legends|Sugi]]|<ref name="BH" />}}
The '''''Halo''''' was an [[SS-54 assault ship/Legends|SS-54 assault ship]] constructed by [[Botajef Shipyards/Legends|Botajef Shipyards]]. During the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy-spanning]] conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the ''Halo'' was used by a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] by the name of [[Sugi (bounty hunter)/Legends|Sugi]] as her personal [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. The ''Halo'' would be used to transport Sugi and her band of mercenaries to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], where together with a trio of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], they [[Skirmish on Felucia/Legends|defended]] a [[Akira/Legends|village]] of [[Felucian/Legends|Felucian]] [[Farm/Legends|farmers]] against the [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] of [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka's]] [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|gang]]. After the pirates had been run off, Sugi offered the stranded group of Jedi safe passage back to [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Realspace/Legends|space]] aboard the ''Halo''.

==Description==
{{Quote|This an odd ship for farmers. Perhaps someone's here to pick up the sillim.|Obi-Wan Kenobi, unaware of ''Halo''{{'s}} true owner|<ref name="BH" />}}
The ''Halo'' was an [[SS-54 assault ship/Legends|SS-54]] [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]], the product of [[Botajef Shipyards/Legends|Botajef Shipyards]].<ref name="CWEG2" /> A far cry from the [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] of [[Botajef/Legends|Botajef's]] other major export, the [[AA-9 Coruscant freighter/Legends|AA-9 Coruscant freighter]],<ref name="Star Wars Insider 61">[[Star Wars Insider 61|''Star Wars Insider'' 61]]</ref> as an SS-54, the ''Halo'' was considerably smaller<ref name="BH" /> and more well-equipped in the area of armament, possessing approximately six [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], four forward and two aft.<ref name="EpGuide" /> Painted a dark green, it was decorated with stripes of white and yellow-[[Color/Legends|colored]] highlights in certain areas along the top [[Hull/Legends|hull]] of the ship.<ref name="BH" /> Painted on the side was a rather demented looking [[Tooka doll/Legends|tooka doll]] holding a knife next to the words 'Nice Playing With Ya' written in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]]. The ''Halo'' became the personal [[Transport/Legends|transport]] of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] named [[Sugi (bounty hunter)/Legends|Sugi]], a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] who operated during the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] conflict known as the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="CWEG2" />

==History==
[[File:Halo_On_Felucia.png|thumb|left|250px|The ''Halo'', laid up on Felucia]]
{{Quote|I seem to find myself light on company. Still need that ride back to the Republic outpost?|Sugi, offering to take the Jedi offworld aboard the ''Halo''|<ref name="BH" />}}
Coming into the possession of the mercenary Sugi at some point prior to the Clone Wars, the ''Halo'' was used as the Zabrak female's personal transport during the conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="CWEG2" /> When the [[Nysillin/Legends|nysillin]] [[Farm/Legends|farmers]] of the [[Felucian/Legends|Felucian]] village [[Akira/Legends|Akira]] contracted Sugi and her crew of mercenaries to defend them against the extortion attempts by the [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] of [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka's]] [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|gang]], it was the ''Halo'' that brought the group to [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]]. During their time on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], ''Halo'' was stored in the large barn used to store the harvested nysillin. Once Ohnaka and his pirates were [[Skirmish on Felucia/Legends|driven off]] in a combined effort from Sugi's mercenaries and a trio of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] including [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]—all of whom had been previously stranded on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] world after their [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] crashed—Sugi offered the Jedi passage off of Felucia and back to Republic [[Realspace/Legends|space]] aboard the ''Halo''.<ref name="BH" />

It was also later used by Sugi and Seripas along with a group of [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] with their commander, [[Tarfful/Legends|Tarfful]] on [[Wasskah/Legends|Wasskah]], to rescue [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], Ahsoka, and a few other prisoners who had been kidnapped by [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]].

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:HomicidalStarfish.svg|thumb|right|150px|Nose art of the ''Halo''. In Aurebesh, it reads:"Nice playing with ya".]]
[[The LEGO Group]] made a set of the ''Halo'', 7930 Bounty Hunter Assault Gunship, which came out at the start of [[2011]]. The set included Embo, Aurra Sing, Sugi, and an IG-86
Assassin Droid. It was featured later that year in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]''.

[[Dave Filoni]] stated that the ''Halo''{{'s}} cockpit and staging area had to be enlarged for its appearance in "Wookiee Hunt".
